title: Alexandria Rewild fidelity notes
description: Acknowledgments for review-mandated edits that genuinely change meaning against the pre-Rewild source. The bound blind review is authoritative for semantic equivalence; these notes suppress only the deterministic clause backstops, and every suppression is recorded in the Rewild receipt.

fidelity_notes.description: At most eight acknowledgments per report. The budget is deliberate: discretion is rationed, and a report needing more acknowledged meaning changes must be re-drafted rather than annotated. Each note documents one edit and is bound to one clause pair; it must match at least one semantic finding or the gate fails closed. Direction reversals, added causal claims, and causal substitutions can never be acknowledged.

source_fragment.description: The edited wording quoted from the pre-Rewild source. Matched as a substring of the compared source prose, ignoring letter case only.

report_fragment.description: The replacement wording quoted from the final report. Matched as a substring of the compared report prose, ignoring letter case only.

reason.description: Why the resolved blind-review finding required this specific meaning change.
